title: WiSE-OD
contribution: Weight-space ensembling for OOD RGB-T detection; introduces LLVIP-C / FLIR-C.
notes: 全文精读（以 arXiv v2 为准）：提出 LLVIP-C / FLIR-C 评测——在 IR 测试集上施 14 种 ImageNet-C 式腐蚀（LLVIP severity 5、FLIR severity 2，因其 JPEG 图像经不起 5 档），以干净 AP50 + mPC 评分；另有 M3FD 真实偏移划分（白天训练的 IR 模型，测雾/夜/雨/室内）。方法 WiSE-OD 为权重空间插值：(1−λ)·θ_RGB^COCO + λ·θ_IR（端点为全量微调或线性探测），λ=0.5 为默认且刻意不在目标数据上调参；一次权重合并，零额外训练与推理成本。Faster R-CNN 在 LLVIP-C 上 mPC 75.83（LP 变体）对全量微调 56.40，干净 AP50 96.24 高于两个父模型；λ 扫描中干净 AP50 在 0.5 达峰、mPC 在 0.3 达峰（76.98）；仅线性探测本身就是强鲁棒基线（mPC 70.96）。M3FD 的标题增益是 YOLOv8 的（相对 FT 的 mAP：雨 +10.8、雾 +7.2、夜 +7.1，平均 +6.3），而 Faster R-CNN 夜间反降（29.4 → 27.9）。集成继承而非治愈父模型失效（severity 5 对比度腐蚀：FT 0.00、WiSE-OD 10.57、LP 51.53）。部署的检测器只用 IR（RGB 只是预训练来源），故本文测的是单模态迁移鲁棒性、不是配对融合退化。代码：heitorrapela/wiseod。

title: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion: From Data Compatibility to Task Adaption
authors: Liu, Wu, Liu, Wang, Jiang, Ma, Zhong, Fan, Liu
contribution: Comprehensive IVIF survey organized around task adaptation.
notes: Authoritative section anchor from the TarDAL/M3FD group.

title: MSOD-Bench: Optimizing Multispectral Object Detection
authors: Zhou, Cheng, Fang, Zhang, Yan, Jia, Xu, Wang, Cao
contribution: Standardized re-implementation/benchmark of 20+ RGB-T detectors.
notes: Fair-comparison framing; guards against cherry-picked baseline numbers.

title: CDDFuse
authors: Zhao, Bai, Zhang, Zhang, Xu, Lin, Timofte, Van Gool
contribution: Correlation-driven dual-branch decomposition fusion, incl. downstream detection.
notes: 纯 IVIF 像素级融合方法：共享 Restormer 浅层特征后双分支分解——LT 块管低频基特征（模态共享）、INN 仿射耦合块管高频细节（模态特有），标志性相关性损失以比值形式同时抬基特征相关、压细节相关（消融中去掉跌幅最大）。检测只是下游验证：M3FD 逐方法重训 YOLOv5，其融合图 mAP@0.5 81.13 最佳（红外 74.62 / 可见光 77.69；该协议下 TarDAL 80.45，与 TarDAL 原文口径不同、不可混引）；无任何退化 / 缺失 / 错位实验。

title: MetaFusion
contribution: Detection-guided meta-feature embedding mutually promoting fusion and detection.
notes: 检测导向像素级融合的第二代表作：元特征嵌入（MFE）以双层元学习把检测语义调制进融合网络，推理时 MFE 拆除、只剩融合网络产图。检测只在 M3FD、且为像素级协议（融合图 → 重训同一 YOLOv5s 比 mAP50→95）：MetaFusion 56.5 最佳；表中无单模态行，融合 vs 单模态之问在其框架内不被提出。本文从未使用 KAIST（常见误引，须纠正）；两模态在融合内始终对称，模态质量 / 冲突完全不建模。

title: TarDAL: Target-aware Dual Adversarial Learning and a Multi-scenario Multi-Modality Benchmark to Fuse Infrared and Visible for Object Detection
authors: Liu, Fan, Huang, Wu, Liu, Zhong, Luo
contribution: Target-aware dual adversarial learning that fuses infrared and visible images for detection; introduced the M3FD benchmark.
notes: 像素级检测导向融合的代表基线，兼 M3FD 数据集出处（4,200 对齐对、33,603 标注、6 类、4 类场景，夜间 1,671 对）：一生成器 + 双判别器（强度域管红外前景热目标、梯度域管可见光背景纹理，R3Net 显著性掩码分区），检测损失梯度回传融合网络做协同训练；推理时判别器拆除、无任何按质量折扣的机制。M3FD 干净 mAP@.5 为 0.807（协同训练 0.811），最强单模态红外 0.781 > 可见光 0.756，融合红利仅约 2.6 点；无模态损坏 / 缺失评测。

title: UniRGB-IR
authors: Yuan, Cui, Zhao, Wang, Fu, Yang, Wei
contribution: Adapter injection of RGB-IR fusion into a frozen ViT foundation model.
notes: 任务层面的统一框架：冻结 ViT-B 基础模型 + 同一套适配器结构（MFP 旁路融合 + SFI 跨注意力注入），以适配器微调分别套到检测 / 分割 / 显著性 / 人脸四任务；没有多数据集联合训练，也没有跨数据集泛化测试。结构上 ViT 主干只吃 RGB，IR 只能经 SFI 逐 stage 注入——RGB 锁定位、原理上排除模态接管。检测数字（Cascade R-CNN 协议）：FLIR mAP 44.1、LLVIP 63.2、KAIST MR 25.21；无退化 / 缺失评测。

title: C2Former: Calibrated and Complementary Transformer
contribution: Cross-attention calibration + adaptive sampling for misaligned RGB-T pairs.
notes: “校准”是隐式的：跨模态注意力的相似度聚合本身完成对齐（无偏移监督），显式偏移只在 AFS 采样环节（以 IR 为参考网格）；互补特征是“用对方 query 引导、聚合本模态自己的 value”，构成双向污染通道；softmax 强制匹配、不能弃权，无任何置信 / 门控。DroneVehicle mAP 74.2（S²A-Net 版；文中另有 73.8 的公平对比行，两数不可混引）、KAIST MR 28.39；失准吸收能力从未用受控偏移量测，无退化 / 缺失实验。

title: DAMSDet
contribution: Competitive query selection + deformable cross-attention in a DETR RGB-T detector.
notes: DETR 路线的动态自适应融合：MCQS 在拼接的两模态编码特征上 Top-K 选初始查询（目标级、仅初始化的一次性硬选择），MDCA 在模态 × 语义层 × 采样点联合集合上 softmax 竞争聚合；动态性是内容驱动的注意力分配，无任何质量 / 退化估计，腐化特征照样能赢得高权重。M3FD mAP50 80.2（作者按场景自划验证集，同表比较须注）、FLIR-aligned 86.6/49.3、LLVIP 97.9/79.1；无损坏 / 缺失模态评测。

title: GM-DETR
authors: Xiao, Meng, Wu, Xu, He, Li
contribution: Lightweight DETR-style RGB-T detector.
notes: 两阶段训练（孤立单模态 → 融合）换取单模态推理能力；融合本体是 CMSF 卷积通路（PANet 式、FPN 锚 RGB）+ 仅 S5 的模态内自注意力 MSFI，并非跨模态注意力融合。缺失靠复制存活模态模拟（表 3）：IR+IR 80.6 ≈ IR 单模态 80.5，但 RGB+RGB 64.3 仍低于纯 RGB 检测器 69.7——训练见过缺失也不保证退化时不劣于丢弃融合（作者自家表格的量化反例）。无部分退化评测；虽为 JRDB workshop 论文，全文零 JRDB 实验。

title: ICAFusion: Iterative Cross-Attention Guided Feature Fusion for Multispectral Object Detection
authors: Shen, Chen, Liu, Zuo, Fan, Yang
contribution: Iterative cross-attention guided feature fusion for multispectral object detection.
notes: Established cross-attention fusion reference, widely used as a comparison baseline (LLVIP, M3FD).

title: Cross-Modality Fusion Transformer (CFT)
contribution: YOLOv5-based transformer cross-modal fusion for RGB-T detection.
notes: 跨模态注意力融合的奠基工作：双流 CSPDarknet53 在第 3/4/5 阶段各插一个 CFT 模块，两模态特征拼接为联合序列做标准自注意力（注意力前全局池化到 8×8，仅全局语义粒度），输出残差加回各支路；对两模态完全对称、无质量感知。FLIR 上朴素双流融合 mAP 37.4 低于热红外单模态 39.5，作者自承粗糙融合加重模态失衡；CFT 抬至 40.2（mAP50 78.7），参数量 206M。无退化 / 缺失模态评测。

title: YOLOv11-RGBT
authors: Wan, Lu, Fang, Lang, Shu, Chen, Shen, Xu, Ye
contribution: Six-fusion-mode study over YOLO/RT-DETR with P3 mid-fusion + controllable fine-tuning (MCF).
notes: YOLO11 的 RGBT 框架论文，稿件基线 YOLO11n-Midfusion 的出处：双流不共享骨干、P3/P4/P5 三节点 neck 融合；文中并存两套口径，引用不可混用——COCO 预训练口径 FLIR 75.20/40.28、LLVIP 96.66/65.83、M3FD 83.63/57.61（mAP50/mAP）。LLVIP 上 Midfusion 两套口径均低于 IR-only（干净数据负融合的外部证据）；MCF 为训练期弱模态注入冻结强模态，与测试时接管不同。全文无缺失 / 损坏模态评测与机制；正文多处转述与表格对不上，引用须查原表。

title: DEYOLO
authors: Chen, Wang, Guo, Zhu, He, Liu, Yuan
contribution: Dual semantic/spatial enhancement modules on YOLOv8 dual streams.
notes: YOLO-line comparator on M3FD + LLVIP.

title: LRAF-Net
authors: Fu, Wang, Duan, Xiao, Dian, Li, Li
contribution: Long-range attention fusion + complementary-mask augmentation vs single-modality bias.
notes: Bridges architecture and imbalance sections; FLIR/LLVIP results.

title: Fusion-Mamba
authors: Dong, Zhu, Lin, Luo, Shen, Liu, Zhang, Guo, Zhang
contribution: State-space (Mamba) cross-modal fusion for IR-VIS detection.
notes: 状态空间融合：FMB（SSCS 通道交换 + 8 个堆叠 DSSF 双门控隐状态混合块）插在双流 YOLOv5/v8 的后三阶段，P3/P4/P5 为两路增强特征直接相加，损失为标准 YOLO 损失、无融合专用监督。仅做检测：LLVIP mAP 64.3、M3FD 61.9、FLIR-aligned 47.0（arXiv 版数字）；YOLOv8 配置 287.6M 参数。门控无质量语义、双模态恒消费、无丢弃 / 回退路径；无损坏 / 缺失模态评测。

title: WaveMamba
authors: Zhu, Dong, Yang, Li, Yang, Ren, Zhu, Feng, Li, Lin, Wang, Luo, Zhang
contribution: Wavelet frequency-decomposed Mamba fusion with YOLOv8 head.
notes: Latest Mamba-line SOTA claim on M3FD/LLVIP/FLIR-Aligned.

title: Learning a Robust RGB-Thermal Detector for Extreme Modality Imbalance
contribution: Base-and-auxiliary training framework for extreme modality imbalance: a quality-aware interaction module (per-stage single-channel spatial masks, cross-addition at CSP stages 3-5) plus training-time pseudo-degradation (global affine x_hat = b + c*x, c~U(0,0.7), prob. 0.3, one modality) and EMA base detector with L2 logit consistency; inference uses the EMA base only.
notes: 全文精读（PRL 196:1–8）：KAIST 干净 LAMR All 8.63（非 SOTA：CPFM 6.62），RGB-only 31.35（CPFM 46.7 / YOLOX-RGBT 64.55）；FLIR AP50 干净 78.8，TIR-only 75.2 对 43.3。测试时高斯噪声 σ=20：8.86/9.56 对 YOLOX-RGBT 的 16.77/25.15。消融：交互模块单独使用反伤失衡 OOD；伪退化单独使用损害干净收敛；EMA 框架同时修复两者。局限：退化族只有一种全局仿射（无模糊/JPEG/局部退化），缺失以对比度降为零模拟，corrupted 与 missing 不分开评，参数 72.18M（作者承认对部署过大）。与模态接管研究最接近的先行工作：属训练期重加权、非推理期修正。

title: CALNet (Cross-Modal Conflict-Aware Learning)
contribution: Rectifies cross-modal feature conflict before selective fusion.
notes: （摘要级记录：全文不可得——ACM 抓取 403、无预印本；以下据官方摘要 + 官方仓库核实）“冲突”指干净对齐输入上两模态因固有异质性产生的语义表征不一致：CCR 以跨模态注意力 + kNN 上下文选择在 token 级吸收处理，无显式冲突分数、无任何模态质量估计；SCF 逐通道权向量调制且每路特征带残差保留进输出，结构上不存在把任一模态压到零的通路。可读来源中只有 DroneVehicle 一个干净基准，无退化 / 缺失评测。

title: Confidence-Aware Fusion via Dempster–Shafer (CMPD)
contribution: Per-modality confidence subnetworks combined evidentially for pedestrian detection.
notes: In-domain precedent for quality/confidence-weighted RGB-T fusion.

title: ProbEn
authors: Chen, Shi, Ye, Mertz, Ramanan, Kong
contribution: Probabilistic late ensembling; marginalization handles missing modalities natively.
notes: 决策级概率集成：条件独立假设下后验乘积（等价 logit 相加，product-of-experts 式），无学出的置信 / 证据估计器，冲突靠乘法压分、近零后验可一票否决。RGB + 热红外，KAIST LAMR 8.50（ProbEn3 7.66）、FLIR AP 83.76。其所谓 handles missing modalities 指检测级缺席（某检测器未在目标上触发），不是传感器级失效 / 损坏；无任何人为损坏实验。其 provably optimal 只是融合规则的贝叶斯最优，不是不劣于单模态的保证。

title: MoME: Resilient Sensor Fusion via Multi-Modal Expert Fusion
contribution: Per-query routing among camera/LiDAR/fused experts by local feature quality.
notes: Strongest analogue of region-dependent takeover (routing, not correction; 3D driving).

title: MEFormer
authors: Cha, Joo, Park, Lee, Kim, Kim
contribution: Defines and mitigates "negative fusion" from defective modalities.
notes: 全文精读：nuScenes 上的相机–LiDAR 3D 检测（基座 CMT）。针对 LiDAR 过度依赖与负融合（弱/噪模态污染另一模态的正确信息）：(i) MOAD——同一解码器跑三条分支（双模 / 仅 LiDAR / 仅相机，仅模态位置编码不同），各分支独立监督、等权重；(ii) PME——对三分支的框特征做带邻近偏置的交叉注意力集成（偏置来自 BEV 中心距离，不估计模态质量）。缺失模态测试时 PME 被禁用，故缺失鲁棒性全部来自 MOAD。干净验证集 73.9 NDS / 71.5 mAP；仅相机 48.0 / 42.5（CMT 44.7 / 38.3；BEVFusion 仅相机 mAP 崩至 0.2）；退化场景全表最佳但仍远低于干净水平（夜间 mAP 43.7）。「防止负融合」只是经验性主张——无形式保证、无负融合指标、无显式模态丢弃。

title: Multimodal Fusion on Low-quality Data: A Comprehensive Survey
authors: Zhang, Wei, Han, Fu, Peng, Deng, Hu, Xu, Wen, Hu, Zhang
contribution: Taxonomy separating noisy, incomplete, imbalanced, quality-varying multimodal data.
notes: Cleanest citation legitimizing the corrupted ≠ missing distinction.

title: DynMM
contribution: On-the-fly gating over modality and fusion-level computation paths.
notes: Dynamic-fusion precedent (efficiency-motivated).

title: Provable Dynamic Fusion for Low-Quality Multimodal Data (QMF)
authors: Zhang, Wu, Zhang, Hu, Fu, Zhou, Peng
contribution: Energy-based uncertainty drives dynamic decision-level fusion weights, with guarantees.
notes: 全文精读：带形式化保证的质量感知动态融合——但保证只覆盖分类。按模态不确定性（能量分数）对决策级融合加权，并以历史损失排序正则强制实现其所假设的「不确定性–损失正相关」。定理 2：当动态权重的期望等于静态权重、且权重与逐模态损失的 Pearson 相关非正时，动态融合的泛化界优于静态融合。实验全部为分类（NYU Depth V2、SUN RGB-D、FOOD-101、MVSA；50% 模态加高斯噪声）：最重腐蚀下四集均为最佳（如 NYU 平均 55.60），但干净 NYU 上反低于 TMC（70.09 对 71.06）。其前提（二分类、逻辑损失、决策级加权、双模态）按原文表述不能迁移到检测。

title: Trusted Multi-View Classification (TMC)
contribution: Evidential per-view quality assessment with Dempster–Shafer fusion.
notes: Foundational trusted/quality-aware fusion citation.

title: SB-BEVFusion
authors: Essl, Moscati, Noman, Zaheer, Naseem, Nawaz, Schedl
contribution: BEV fusion explicitly treating corrupted vs missing sensors as distinct cases.
notes: Verbatim corrupted-vs-missing distinction; very recent, camera-LiDAR.

title: MultiCorrupt
contribution: 10 LiDAR-camera corruptions × 3 severities with Resistance Ability metric.
notes: Severity-graded corruption evaluation model.

title: Benchmarking Robustness of 3D Object Detection to Common Corruptions
authors: Dong, Kang, Zhang, Zhu, Wang, Yang, Su, Wei, Zhu
contribution: 27-corruption benchmark; fusion models more robust, motion corruptions worst.
notes: Corruption-protocol precedent for the manuscript's degradation suite.

title: MM-CKD
contribution: Cross-modal knowledge distillation robust to missing modality (sentiment).
notes: Only distillation-for-missing citation found; non-vision.

title: MMPareto
contribution: Pareto-integrated gradients resolving multimodal/unimodal gradient conflict.
notes: Gradient-conflict framing.

title: Multimodal Learning with Missing Modalities: A Survey
contribution: Survey of imputation/representation/distillation approaches to missing modalities.
notes: Section anchor for Q3.

title: ReconBoost
contribution: Modality-alternating boosting with KL reconcilement vs competition.
notes: Most recent reconcilement-framed balancing method.

title: PMR: Prototypical Modal Rebalance
contribution: Prototypes accelerate the slow-learning modality; entropy regularizer vs dominant modality.
notes: Balancing line representative.

title: ShaSpec
authors: Wang, Chen, Ma, Avery, Hull, Carneiro
contribution: Shared-specific features + residual fusion for missing modality at train/test.
notes: Representation-side missing-modality approach.

title: OGM-GE
contribution: On-the-fly gradient modulation by modality contribution discrepancy.
notes: Standard balancing citation next to the existing competition papers.

title: SMIL
authors: Ma, Ren, Zhao, Tulyakov, Wu, Peng
contribution: Bayesian meta-learning for severely (≤90%) missing modalities.
notes: Canonical missing-modality method citation.

title: Inference-Time Intervention (ITI)
contribution: Shifts selected attention-head activations along probed directions at inference.
notes: Terminological namesake of "intervention"; LLM-only, one clarifying sentence.

title: MEMO
contribution: Per-test-point adaptation via marginal entropy over augmentations.
notes: Single-point test-time intervention precedent.

title: Tent
contribution: Test-time entropy minimization over norm affine parameters.
notes: Canonical "adapt at test time" contrast (parameter-level, unsupervised).

title: OptNet
contribution: Differentiable QP layers via implicit KKT differentiation.
notes: Foundational only; redundant given existing Amos/CF-OPT citations.

title: Visible-Thermal Tiny Object Detection: A Benchmark Dataset and Baselines (RGBT-Tiny)
contribution: RGBT-Tiny benchmark: 115 paired sequences, 93K frames, 1.2M annotations in 7 categories (over 81% of objects under 16x16 px), plus the SAFit evaluation measure and extensive baseline evaluations.
notes: The standard tiny-object RGBT benchmark; also a datasets.md entry.

title: SuperYOLO: Super Resolution Assisted Object Detection in Multimodal Remote Sensing Imagery
contribution: Pixel-level multimodal fusion inside a YOLOv5-style detector plus a super-resolution auxiliary branch (removed at inference) to recover small-object detail.
notes: One of the most-cited YOLO-family multispectral detectors (VEDAI); a detection-native pixel-level entry.

title: Cross-Modality Interactive Attention Network for Multispectral Pedestrian Detection (CIAN)
contribution: Interactive attention module encoding inter-modality correlations to recalibrate channel responses of halfway features before fusion.
notes: Early, heavily cited cross-modal attention design that predates and motivates the transformer fusion line.

title: Guided Attentive Feature Fusion for Multispectral Pedestrian Detection (GAFF)
contribution: Inter- and intra-modality attention modules dynamically weigh and fuse multispectral features at low computational cost.
notes: A widely used comparison point in CFT-era papers; an efficiency-conscious attention baseline.

title: Improving RGB-Infrared Object Detection with Cascade Alignment-Guided Transformer (CAGT)
contribution: Cascades region alignment (TSRA-style) with a complementary fusion transformer inside an RoI detection head; evaluated on DroneVehicle and KAIST.
notes: Transformer-era successor to TSFADet and a sibling of C2Former; strengthens the alignment-aware cluster.

title: Multispectral Deep Neural Networks for Pedestrian Detection (Halfway Fusion)
contribution: Systematically compared early / late / halfway fusion in a two-branch Faster R-CNN and showed mid-level (halfway) fusion works best on KAIST.
notes: The founding deep-learning baseline of the KAIST era; nearly every later pedestrian paper benchmarks against it.

title: Multispectral Pedestrian Detection via Simultaneous Detection and Segmentation (MSDS-RCNN)
contribution: Two-stage multispectral R-CNN jointly optimising detection and semantic segmentation, with a sanitised re-annotation of KAIST training data.
notes: A standard KAIST-era strong baseline; its sanitised annotations are still used by later work.

title: Weakly Aligned Cross-Modal Learning for Multispectral Pedestrian Detection (AR-CNN)
contribution: Region Feature Alignment module predicting and correcting per-modality position shifts inside Faster R-CNN, with RoI jitter training on per-modality annotations.
notes: The reference work for the misalignment problem in pedestrian detection.

title: MLPD: Multi-Label Pedestrian Detector in Multispectral Domain
contribution: Multi-label learning with modality-specific (non-paired) box annotations, so RGB and thermal labels need not coincide — enables training on unpaired multispectral data.
notes: The supervision-side answer to label misalignment, complementing AR-CNN's feature-side alignment.

title: BAANet: Learning Bi-Directional Adaptive Attention Gates for Multispectral Pedestrian Detection
contribution: Bi-directional adaptive attention gates progressively distil modality-specific noise and recalibrate both streams, with illumination-based weighting of interaction strength.
notes: A strong, fast KAIST baseline from the attention-gate family.

title: Learning a Dynamic Cross-Modal Network for Multispectral Pedestrian Detection (DCMNet)
contribution: Dynamically aggregates local and non-local cross-modal context when fusing the streams, instead of a fixed fusion rule.
notes: The main dynamic-fusion representative in pedestrian detection.

title: Translation, Scale and Rotation: Cross-Modal Alignment Meets RGB-Infrared Vehicle Detection (TSFADet)
contribution: TSRA module calibrating feature maps for translation, scale and rotation deviations between modalities, plus a modality-selection strategy, in a two-stream detector for DroneVehicle.
notes: The reference alignment paper for aerial RGBT, where weak misalignment (position/size/angle) is the defining problem.

title: TFDet: Target-Aware Fusion for RGB-T Pedestrian Detection
contribution: Fusion-then-refinement with a segmentation branch and a correlation-maximum loss enhancing pedestrian/background feature contrast to suppress false positives.
notes: Recent SOTA-level results on KAIST, LLVIP, FLIR and M3FD — doubles as a general-detection entry.

title: Weakly Aligned Feature Fusion for Multimodal Object Detection
contribution: Journal extension of the AR-CNN line: weakly aligned feature fusion generalised from pedestrian detection to multimodal object detection.
notes: Bridges pedestrian alignment work and general detection. Early access 2021; issue (vol. 36) published 2025 per Crossref.

title: Fusion of Multispectral Data Through Illumination-Aware Deep Neural Networks for Pedestrian Detection (IATDNN)
contribution: Illumination-aware weighting mechanism modulating a two-stream CNN, trained multi-task with semantic segmentation.
notes: With the illumination-aware Faster R-CNN it defines the day/night adaptive-weighting line that quality-aware methods still cite.

title: Improving Multispectral Pedestrian Detection by Addressing Modality Imbalance Problems (MBNet)
contribution: Differential Modality Aware Fusion plus an illumination-aware feature alignment module, explicitly framed around the modality-imbalance problem in two-stream optimisation.
notes: The named origin of 'modality imbalance' as a pedestrian-detection problem.

title: Drone-Based RGB-Infrared Cross-Modality Vehicle Detection via Uncertainty-Aware Learning (UA-CMDet)
contribution: Introduces the DroneVehicle dataset (28,439 RGB-IR pairs) and weights cross-modal learning by per-object uncertainty from cross-modal IoU and illumination, with illumination-aware NMS.
notes: The aerial anchor paper: DroneVehicle is the standard aerial RGBT benchmark and this is its source paper.

title: Removal and Selection: Improving RGB-Infrared Object Detection via Coarse-to-Fine Fusion
contribution: Coarse-to-fine fusion: first remove modality noise/redundancy from features, then select complementary cross-modal information.
notes: A recent general RGB-IR detection paper framing fusion as noise removal + selection — a clean modern representative of the quality/conflict-aware line.

title: Illumination-Aware Faster R-CNN for Robust Multispectral Pedestrian Detection
contribution: Estimates scene illumination and uses it as a gate to adaptively weight the RGB and thermal sub-networks' detection scores.
notes: The canonical illumination-gated late-fusion design; anchors the decision-level end of the taxonomy.

title: Distribution-Aligned Multimodal Fusion for Robust Object Detection
contribution: Freezes a pretrained detector and trains only a lightweight fusion module that aligns fused features to the pretrained (clean) feature distribution, generalizing to unseen degradation types.
notes: 全文精读：冻结 ViT-Base + DETR 检测器（86M），只训融合模块（13M），以负对数似然损失把融合特征的 [CLS] 对齐到 P_normal——由 5k 张目标域正常图像特征拟合的 K=8 对角 GMM（并非预训练分布）。跨退化协议（只用过曝训练）：对齐到 P_normal 能泛化到未见退化（夜间 76.8、模糊 40.6 mAP50），对齐到退化分布则已见项略胜、未见项明显落后（67.5 / 28.5）。三集均为最佳（LLVIP 98.1、FLIR 79.5、DroneVehicle 57.8 mAP50），但过曝保持率仅约正常水平的 48%。无模态缺失评测（默认 IR 始终完好）；退化生成参数未报告；未与输入级质量衰减基线比较。

title: InfraNet: Quality-Aware RGB Guidance for Infrared Object Detection
authors: Feng, Zhu, Yang, Xu, Ren, Yang, Liu, Zhang, Wang, Yang, Zhang
contribution: IR-centric asymmetric detector whose QualGate module learns a task-oriented control signal to suppress unreliable RGB guidance during cross-modal training; supports RGB-IR or IR-only deployment.
notes: 全文精读：非对称设计——IR 为主路，RGB 降级为训练期特权指导，由 QualGate 控制：单个标量 q（GAP + 瓶颈 MLP + sigmoid，无质量监督、纯任务驱动）按 q 缩放 RGB 贡献，并以 α(q)=clip(1.5−q; 1.0, 1.5) 反向放大 IR。InfraNet-IR 推理时整支删除 RGB（参数与时延与纯 IR 基线完全相同，却靠 RGB 指导训练在 M3FD 上 +1.4/+1.8 mAP50/mAP）；InfraNet-RGB-IR 保留双路并在线门控。受控退化只覆盖 RGB 的雾与亮度（五档、无物理定义、IR 固定），且 q 在雾下的动态范围极小（约 0.007）。无 IR 退化、无缺失率曲线；结果为单次运行、无方差。

title: M-SpecGene: Generalized Foundation Model for RGBT Multispectral Vision
contribution: Self-supervised RGBT foundation model using a Cross-Modality Structural Sparsity metric and GMM-based progressive masking to pretrain modality-invariant representations.
notes: Validated across eleven datasets and four RGBT downstream tasks including detection (ICCV 2025, pp. 7861-7872). The dedicated RGBT pretraining counterpart to UniRGB-IR.

title: Fusion Meets Diverse Conditions: A High-diversity Benchmark and Baseline for UAV-based Multimodal Object Detection with Condition Cues
contribution: Introduces ATR-UMOD, a UAV RGB-IR dataset with 11 categories and six per-pair condition attributes (altitude, angle, time, weather, illumination, scenario), plus the prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion baseline PCDF.
notes: Training/test split of 11,850/1,503 pairs with conditions annotated, enabling condition-specific robustness evaluation.

title: Rethinking Multi-modal Object Detection from the Perspective of Mono-Modality Feature Learning (M2D-LIF)
contribution: Identifies 'fusion degradation' from insufficient mono-modality learning in joint training; counters it with mono-modality distillation plus a local illumination-aware fusion module.
notes: 提出并命名 Fusion Degradation（单模态可检出、融合反而漏检），归因于联合训练下单模态骨干学习不充分（冻结骨干线性探针为据）；以每模态冻结的单模态教师做模态内蒸馏 + SimAM 注意力图引导的跨模态蒸馏（推理时教师与蒸馏移除、零开销），LIF 光照权重构造性限制在 [0.3, 0.7]，任一模态不能被完全压掉。干净基准成绩：FLIR mAP 46.1、LLVIP 70.8、DroneVehicle mAP50 81.4；无损坏 / 缺失模态鲁棒性评测。原文未评测 RGBT-Tiny（其 AP 38.7 出自 DyFCLT 的对比表）。

title: Mixed Patch Visible-Infrared Modality Agnostic Object Detection (MiPa)
contribution: Trains a single shared transformer encoder on patch-mixed RGB/IR inputs so the detector needs only one modality at inference, countering modality dominance.
notes: 模态无关检测：训练期将对齐的可见光 / 红外图像对逐块互补采样（比例 ρ）拼成单幅马赛克图喂共享编码器，逐 batch 从 U(0,1) 重抽 ρ 的 Variable 方案最好（LLVIP 双路均值 AP50 93.00）；推理期只输入单模态，模型无双路推理模式。评测仅覆盖模态缺失（部署侧决定），无任何模态损坏 / 退化评测；RGB 侧仍低于 RGB 专门模型 1.77 点，无最坏情况保证。其自带整图级混合基线 Both 明显更差，可作整图级混合买不到模态平衡的对照。

title: Contextually-Guided State Space Fusion for Misaligned Multi-Spectral Object Detection (CSSFDet)
contribution: Selective state-space fusion module that uses global semantic context to compensate local features degraded by cross-modal misalignment (ACM MM 2025, pp. 2526-2535).
notes: Reports 84.1% mAP50 on DroneVehicle and robustness analyses under synthetic data shifts.

title: Multispectral State-Space Feature Fusion: Bridging Shared and Cross-Parametric Interactions for Object Detection
contribution: State-space feature fusion that separately models shared and cross-parametric cross-modal interactions for multispectral detection (Information Fusion, Mar 2026 issue).
notes: Full author list verified via Crossref (Shen, Zhan, Dong, Zuo, Yang, Ling).

title: Pseudo Visible Feature Fine-Grained Fusion for Thermal Object Detection (PFGF)
contribution: Fuses thermal features with pseudo-visible features from a thermal-to-visible translation prior via a graph-Mamba module; training uses paired data but testing is thermal-only (CVPR 2025, pp. 6710-6719).
notes: Evaluated on FLIR, LLVIP and an autonomous-vehicles dataset against thermal-only detectors.

title: DDFD: Diffusion-Based Denoising Fusion for Object Detection in Infrared-Visible Images
contribution: Treats image fusion as a diffusion denoising process with an image-adaptive visible-enhancement module, jointly optimized with the detector (ACM MM 2025, pp. 1452-1461).
notes: Experiments on M3FD, DroneVehicle and VEDAI, including challenging-weather conditions. The Pixel-Level line's first diffusion-based entry.

title: E2E-MFD: Towards End-to-End Synchronous Multimodal Fusion Detection
contribution: Single-phase end-to-end joint optimization of image fusion and detection with a gradient-matrix strategy for shared parameters, avoiding staged sub-optimal training.
notes: Reports +3.9 mAP50 on M3FD and +2.0 on DroneVehicle over prior fusion-detection pipelines. Code repo is the authors' EfficientMFD repo.

title: DetFusion: A Detection-driven Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Network
contribution: Modality-specific detectors supply object attention maps through a shared attention module that biases the fusion decoder toward object regions (ACM MM 2022, pp. 4003-4011).
notes: Authors Sun, Cao, Zhu, Hu - the Tianjin group behind UA-CMDet and CMPD. A standard task-driven fusion-detection baseline.

title: Stabilizing Multispectral Pedestrian Detection with Evidential Hybrid Fusion
authors: Li, Zhang, Hu, Zhu, Fu, Chen
contribution: Evidential hybrid fusion combining feature- and decision-level evidence under Dempster-Shafer theory to stabilize pedestrian detection under modality uncertainty.
notes: Early access 2023; journal issue Apr 2024 (Crossref) - year recorded by issue date, following the repo's Weakly Aligned Feature Fusion precedent.

title: Multiscale Cross-modal Homogeneity Enhancement and Confidence-aware Fusion for Multispectral Pedestrian Detection
contribution: Enhances cross-modal feature homogeneity at multiple scales, then fuses with per-modality confidence estimates for pedestrian detection.
notes: Published online 2023; TMM issue year 2024 (Crossref) - year recorded by issue date per repo precedent.

title: Causal Mode Multiplexer: A Novel Framework for Unbiased Multispectral Pedestrian Detection
contribution: Causal-inference framework that removes dataset statistical bias between modalities (day/night label co-occurrence), with a new ROTX-MP evaluation set for modality bias.
notes: Evaluated on KAIST, CVC-14, FLIR and the new bias-focused split. Modality bias treated causally rather than by reweighting.

title: Mask-Guided Mamba Fusion for Drone-based Visible-Infrared Vehicle Detection
contribution: Mask-guided state-space fusion for drone-based visible-infrared vehicle detection on DroneVehicle.
notes: Full author list verified via Crossref (Wang, Wang, Shi, Liu, Lu). The earliest journal Mamba detection entry; anchors the start of the Mamba line.

title: Misaligned Visible-Thermal Object Detection: A Drone-based Benchmark and Baseline (DVTOD)
contribution: Drone-based benchmark of deliberately misaligned visible-thermal pairs with a baseline detector, quantifying misalignment sensitivity.
notes: The misalignment counterpart to the aligned DroneVehicle benchmark referenced throughout the list.

title: When Pedestrian Detection Meets Multi-Modal Learning: Generalist Model and Benchmark Dataset (MMPedestron)
contribution: A generalist pedestrian detector handling dynamic combinations of RGB, IR, depth, LiDAR and event inputs, plus the MMPD benchmark aggregating existing datasets and a new RGB-Event set.
notes: Handles missing/dynamic modality combinations by design, unlike fixed-pair specialist detectors.

title: CF-Deformable DETR: An End-to-End Alignment-Free Model for Weakly Aligned Visible-Infrared Object Detection
contribution: Alignment-free DETR whose cross-modal deformable attention maps points between modalities directly, guided by a point-level feature consistency loss in hyperbolic space.
notes: Maintains accuracy across varying synthetic offset degrees on KAIST, FLIR and LLVIP. The DETR cluster's first alignment-free representative.

title: SAM-Guided Semantic Knowledge Fusion for Visible-Infrared Object Detection
contribution: Injects SAM-derived semantic knowledge into visible-infrared feature fusion to guide object-level complementarity (ACM MM 2025, pp. 8835-8844).
notes: Same UESTC group as PFGF; the two are distinct methods and venues.

title: Weakly Misalignment-free Adaptive Feature Alignment for UAVs-based Multimodal Object Detection (OAFA)
contribution: Estimates cross-modal offsets in a modality-invariant common subspace and performs offset-guided deformable alignment instead of strict registration.
notes: CVPR 2024 aerial-alignment counterpart to the pedestrian-side AR-CNN lineage.

title: EI²Det: Edge-Guided Illumination-Aware Interactive Learning for Visible-Infrared Object Detection
contribution: Edge-guided, illumination-aware interactive learning between the two streams for visible-infrared detection, with the accompanying MFAD dataset.
notes: Full author list verified via Crossref (Hu, He, Li, Zhao, Chen, Kang), TCSVT Jul 2025.

title: Efficient Multispectral Object Detection with Attentive Feature Aggregation Leveraging Zero-Shot Implicit Illumination Guidance
contribution: Attentive feature aggregation steered by zero-shot implicit illumination estimates, targeting efficient multispectral detection (Information Fusion, Jun 2025).
notes: Journal record and author list verified via Crossref. An efficiency-focused entry in the otherwise accuracy-only Quality subsection.

title: IRDFusion: Iterative Relation-map Difference Guided Feature Fusion for Multispectral Object Detection
contribution: Iteratively refines cross-modal fusion using differences between relation maps of the two modalities (Pattern Recognition, Aug 2026 issue).
notes: Distinct from the same group's ICAFusion (already listed) - a separate method and Crossref record.

title: MODA: The First Challenging Benchmark for Multispectral Object Detection in Aerial Images
contribution: Large-scale aerial multispectral detection dataset (14,041 images, 330,191 oriented annotations, 8 categories) with the OSSDet spectral-spatial baseline.
notes: Scope note: an 8-band multispectral (390-950 nm) single-sensor dataset, not a paired visible-LWIR set; kept in the appendix as a neighbouring benchmark (AAAI 2026).

title: SM3Det: A Unified Model for Multi-Modal Remote Sensing Object Detection
contribution: Single unified detector trained jointly across multi-modal remote-sensing datasets (including RGB and infrared) with a grid-level sparse MoE backbone and cross-task optimization balancing.
notes: Scope note: unifies per-modality datasets (RGB / IR / SAR) in one model rather than fusing paired VIS-thermal inputs; appendix as a unified-model reference (AAAI 2026).

title: Bridging Multimodal Fusion and Expert Routing via Spectral Reliability Descriptors for Robust Object Detection
contribution: Parameter-free 7-D spectral reliability descriptors computed at fusion time drive both spectral reliability fusion (SRF) and reliability-conditioned expert routing (RCER) for RGB-infrared detection.
notes: 全文精读：在对齐后的 RGB/IR 特征谱（P4/P5）上无参数、停梯度地算出 7 维光谱可靠性描述子（分带能量、幅度比、相位一致性、跨谱相关），一次算出、两处复用——SRF 中门控融合（在光谱交互特征与保守的双路均值回退之间混合），RCER 中为 top-2 任务专家（Texture / Saliency / Recovery + 常开共享专家）路由，基座为 DEIM/D-FINE。受控消融（5 种子）：换路由信号的收益大于换专家结构（+0.7~0.9 对 +0.6~0.8）；DroneVehicle 六种单一强度合成退化的平均保持率 95.0%，拼接基线 87.9%（模态丢弃一项 90.9%）。描述子为全局量，按设计不处理空间非平稳可靠性；其跨方法主表为转录数字、非同配方重跑。

title: LER-YOLO: Reliability-Aware Expert Routing for Misaligned RGB-Infrared UAV Detection
contribution: Uncertainty-aware target alignment resamples visible features onto the infrared reference, and a reliability-guided sparse mixture-of-experts routes among RGB-dominant, IR-dominant and interaction experts.
notes: 面向未对齐 RGB-IR UAV 检测：U-TA 估计稠密形变场对齐 RGB 特征，并以对齐后两路特征的 L1 一致性自监督出空间可靠性图 R；融合前先以 R 软门控 RGB 特征，再由内容路由器对 RGB 主导 / IR 主导 / 交互三专家做软加权（默认 top-k=3 即全选，无硬路由）。MBU 基准受控协议内优于静态融合，但相对增益随合成平移增大而消失（40 px 时为 0）；消融显示无可靠性引导的 MoE 已拿走大部分增益。仅评测几何错位，无模态损坏 / 缺失评测，无测试时适应；补充表 S1–S3 未随 arXiv 发布。

title: Modality-Decoupled RGB-Thermal Object Detector via Query Fusion
contribution: MDQF runs two independent DETR-like branches for RGB and thermal and exchanges selected high-quality queries between refinement stages (Query Fusion), balancing complementarity against modality separation.
notes: The decoupled design also lets each branch be optimised on unpaired single-modality images. Same group as the sparse cross-modality fusion entry (arXiv:2606.30215). No official code found.

title: Representation Space Constrained Learning with Modality Decoupling for Multimodal Object Detection
contribution: Analyses fusion degradation in multimodal detection (suppressed single-modality gradients, stronger for the weak modality) and counters it with a representation-space constraint (RSC) and a modality-decoupling (MD) module.
notes: Evaluated on FLIR, LLVIP, M3FD and MFAD. Official repository linked from the paper (code upload marked in progress there). A training-side companion to the negative-fusion line (cf. MEFormer, QMF in the appendix).

title: Bridging Severe Cross-Modal Misalignment: End-to-End Visible-Infrared Object Detection via Explicit Feature-Domain Affine Registration
contribution: JFRDet performs explicit feature-domain affine registration (Cross-Modal Affine Alignment) with illumination-guided complementary fusion for severely misaligned visible-infrared pairs.
notes: Introduces the DroneVehicle Misaligned (DVMA) benchmark for severe geometric misalignment; 69.7% mAP50 reported. Code and dataset announced as forthcoming; none released yet.

title: Towards a Generalizable Fusion Architecture for Multimodal Object Detection
contribution: FMCAF combines a frequency-domain Freq-Filter that suppresses redundant spectral features with multimodal cross-attention fusion, aiming for generalisation without dataset-specific tuning.
notes: ICCV 2025 Workshops, pp. 2192-2200 (per the official repository's BibTeX); arXiv version linked. +1.1% / +13.9% mAP@50 over concatenation fusion on LLVIP / VEDAI reported. Its VEDAI benchmark is RGB + near-infrared (NIR), not RGB-thermal.

title: Efficient RGB-T Object Detection via Sparse Cross-Modality Fusion
contribution: Two-stage sparse fusion: a lightweight single-modality detector proposes high-recall RoIs, and only those sparse candidates receive fusion-driven re-checking and box refinement.
notes: Cuts the cost of dense dual-backbone full-image fusion while keeping competitive accuracy. Same group as MDQF (arXiv:2601.08458). No official code found.

title: Physical Adversarial Clothing Evades Visible-Thermal Detectors via Non-Overlapping RGB-T Pattern
contribution: Physical adversarial clothing whose visible and thermal patterns are mutually non-overlapping (NORP), jointly optimised on a 3D RGB-T human model with fusion-stage ensembling for transfer to unseen detectors.
notes: An attack paper, not a detector: catalogued in the core list (Surveys & Benchmarks) as a physical-robustness evaluation of paired RGB-T detectors across fusion architectures. CVPR 2026, pp. 13356-13365 (pages per citing references); also arXiv:2605.04675.

title: Thermal-Det: Language-Guided Cross-Modal Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Thermal Object Detection
contribution: First LLM-supervised open-vocabulary thermal detector: builds over a million synthetic thermal-aligned samples from GroundingCap-1M and distils from a frozen RGB teacher on unlabelled paired RGB-T data.
notes: Thermal-only at inference; paired RGB-T data serves training-time distillation only. +2-4% AP over existing open-vocabulary detectors on thermal benchmarks reported. CVPR 2026 per arXiv comments, with the CVF supplemental on file. No official code found.

title: UAV-CB: A Complex-Background RGB-T Dataset and Local Frequency Bridge Network for UAV Detection
contribution: A complex-background RGB-T UAV-detection dataset (3,442 pairs across five background types, incl. camouflage scenes) with LFBNet, a local frequency bridge that aligns and fuses the two modalities in local frequency space.
notes: Dataset/benchmark paper with a baseline method; the detection targets are UAVs themselves in cluttered low-altitude scenes. CVPR 2026 (CVF supplemental on file). No official code found.

title: CD-Buffer: Complementary Dual-Buffer Framework for Test-Time Adaptation in Adverse Weather Object Detection
contribution: Couples additive (feature refinement) and subtractive (domain-sensitive channel removal) test-time adaptation paradigms in a dual-buffer framework, balanced per channel by a unified feature-level discrepancy measure.
notes: 全文精读：面向恶劣天气的单模态 RGB 检测测试时自适应（Faster R-CNN + ResNet-50）。通道级域差异 D（当前批次特征与离线源统计的距离，图像级 + 实例级两路）同时驱动两个互补缓冲：减性缓冲的通道掩码 L1 正则按 D 加权（偏移重的通道更易被剪除），加性适配器对各通道的补偿强度则取同一掩码分数反转得到的逆软掩码——同一把差异尺子同时决定剪与补。适应信号为源统计对齐损失（不用熵、不用伪标签）。KITTI fog 50m：21.27 → 44.80 mAP50；雾强度阶梯上的持续 TTA 平均 55.66，高于 WHW 的 50.17；但并非全胜（中等雨量与 ACDC 雪一项分别落后 WHW 与 BufferTTA）。需随模型携带源统计且依赖批次估计；通道剪除依赖 BN 结构。

title: MM-TTA: Multi-Modal Test-Time Adaptation for 3D Semantic Segmentation
contribution: Extends test-time adaptation to multi-modal 3D semantic segmentation with intra-modal pseudo-labelling and inter-modal pseudo-label refinement, each modality regularising the other.
notes: CVPR 2022, pp. 16928-16937; also arXiv:2204.12667. Segmentation rather than detection; the canonical multi-modal TTA reference. No official code repository confirmed.

title: Test-time Adaptation against Multi-modal Reliability Bias
contribution: READ names the reliability-bias failure of multi-modal TTA (modality-wise shifts make cross-modal reliability uneven) and counters it with self-adaptive attention modulation plus a robust objective that amplifies confident predictions and suppresses noisy ones.
notes: 全文精读：提出并形式化「可靠性偏倚」——一个模态受损后，模态间信息量差距被拉大，朴素融合可能反差于单模态。READ 在测试时双管齐下：(i) 自适应注意力融合——只更新跨模态注意力的 Q/K/V 投影，使注意力向可靠模态重新配权；(ii) 置信感知损失——梯度非单调（高置信样本被放大、低置信样本被反转/抑制，有两个定理支撑），另加类别平衡负熵项。在音视频分类上评测（CAV-MAE；Kinetics50-C / VGGSound-C，每次只腐蚀一个模态，severity 5）：视频受损 Kinetics50-C 62.5（源模型 59.9）；音频受损 VGGSound-C 32.4 对 25.6，而 Tent / MM-TTA 崩至约 4.5 / 7.6。消融显示 SAF 若配普通 Tent 熵损失反不如不适应（雾下 34.9 → 22.7）。仅限分类；要求模型带注意力融合层；无双模同时受损与模态缺失协议。

title: Smoothing the Shift: Towards Stable Test-Time Adaptation under Complex Multimodal Noises
contribution: SuMi targets wild multi-modal test-time adaptation: IQR smoothing against abrupt distribution shifts, unimodal-guided selection of low-entropy information-rich samples, and mutual-information sharing across modalities.
notes: 全文精读：定义多模态 wild TTA——弱 OOD（单模态受损）、强 OOD（双模同时受损、单模缺失、缺失+受损的 Mix）与混合流，评测于音视频分类（CAV-MAE；Kinetics50-C / VGGSound-C）。核心是平滑适应轨迹：IQR 样本门控（在融合表示上按四分位距选样、区间随迭代放宽，先易后难）；单模态辅助筛选（只留真正需要双模态的样本：多模态熵低、但单模态熵之和不能太低）；互信息共享损失（把单模态预测分布拉向互补模态与融合分布的平均，强 OOD 下只开前一半迭代）。Kinetics50-C 强 OOD 平均 33.4，Tent 仅 11.2、源模型 30.0；消融中 IQR 平滑单项贡献最大（31.7 → 45.1）。仅限分类；缺失只作类型、未作剂量（无缺失率曲线）；强 OOD 绝对精度仍低（Mix 仅 18.4）。

title: DyFCLT: Dynamic Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Modal Learning Transformer for Multimodal Tiny Object Detection
authors: Li, Dai, Li, Yao, Jiang, Zheng
contribution: Dynamic frequency-band decoupled cross-modal attention (DFCA) plus Selective Smoothing Enhancement (SSE) for RGBT tiny object detection.
notes: Frequency-domain RGBT tiny-object detector: DFCA decomposes Q/K/V features into B=3 dynamic frequency subbands for band-wise cross-modal attention; SSE suppresses background noise and guides multiscale upsampling. RGBT-Tiny AP 48.2 / AP50 69.1 / APs_t 41.3 (vs M2D-LIF 38.7/54.9/29.0); RGBTDronePerson AP50 61.0; FLIR AP 45.0 / AP50 84.1. CVPR 2026, pp. 11313–11323 (pages per citing references).
